name: Composable Architecture XCTest contract
source: Public interfaces and compile-passing tests in the locally resolved subject package
import_rule: Import every module listed in source_imports when the test directly names a type from that module. The focal module still uses @testable import MODULE_NAME.

type_placeholders.FEATURE: Replace with the reducer type under test

available_api_patterns: let store = TestStore(initialState: FEATURE.State()) { FEATURE() } withDependencies: { $0.continuousClock = clock }
await store.send(ACTION) { state in state.PROPERTY = EXPECTED_VALUE }
await store.receive(EXPECTED_EQUATABLE_ACTION) { state in state.PROPERTY = EXPECTED_VALUE }
await store.receive(\.ACTION_CASE) { state in state.PROPERTY = EXPECTED_VALUE }
receive_rule: If the feature Action is not explicitly Equatable, or the received case contains Error, TaskResult, or another non-Equatable value, receive it with its case key path such as await store.receive(\.postsResponse), never by constructing the associated action value. Use direct receive(EXPECTED_ACTION) only when Action is explicitly Equatable.
state_initializer_rule: Use FEATURE.State() unless an exact different initializer declaration is supplied. Never infer a memberwise initializer for a type that declares its own init().
assertion_closure_rule: When an action causes no observable state mutation, call send or receive without a trailing closure. A trailing assertion closure is allowed only when it accepts the state parameter and changes it to the expected value.
unavailable_api_forms: await store.send(ACTION) { /* empty or comments only */ }
await store.receive(ACTION) { /* empty or comments only */ }
FEATURE.State(PROPERTY: VALUE) unless that initializer is explicitly supplied
concurrency_constraints: Annotate an XCTestCase using TestStore with @MainActor under this Swift 6 toolchain
Await TestStore send and receive operations
Create TestStore inside each test method; do not override XCTest setUp or tearDown with actor-isolated state
